basis: standardized direction and cohort-specific adjusted support; no cross-scale magnitude comparison

program_rules.PORTABLE: at least two STRONG_PORTABLE methods without discordance
program_rules.PARTIALLY_PORTABLE_CONTEXT_DEPENDENT: at least two concordant methods including at least one STRONG_PORTABLE method without discordance
program_rules.DIRECTIONALLY_CONSISTENT_INSUFFICIENT: at least two concordant methods without strong support and without discordance
